tldr: Mars through the 3rd house brings focus to communication, learning, siblings, neighbors, and daily movement.
body: Mars transiting the 3rd house energizes communication, learning, siblings, neighbors, and daily movement. For about six weeks, drive, heat, conflict, desire, and action move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is an activation transit: it brings momentum and courage, but also heat that needs a clear outlet.
business: Mars supports writing, messaging, and local connection: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Impulsiveness, conflict, burnout, or scattered attention or reactive speech.
advice: Aim the fire in the 3rd house deliberately. Work with communication, learning, siblings, neighbors, and daily movement without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from Marie Satori house-transit material.
